title: IRCO Observation (Pivot Format v0)
description: Single observation record in the IRCO pivot format. Every data source must produce records conforming to this schema before ingestion into the Rust storage layer.

id.description: Globally unique observation identifier. Convention: {source_prefix}-{dataset}-{sequence}. Examples: iss-rr1-000001, noaa-xray-20261114-000001, a01-000001.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the observation. All sources must be normalized to UTC.

subject_id.description: Identifier of the observed subject (astronaut, analog participant, simulated crew member). Null for environmental/ambient measurements.

indicator.description: Machine-readable indicator name. Must match an entry in the indicator registry. Examples: heart_rate, spo2, temperature_iss, co2_cabin, radiation_dose_daily, sleep_duration.

value.description: Numeric value of the observation in the specified unit.

unit.description: SI or domain-standard unit. Examples: bpm, percent, degC, ppm, mSv, hours, score.

source.description: Data source identifier. Format: {provider}_{dataset}. Examples: NASA_OSDR_EDA, NOAA_SWPC, PHYSIONET_MIMIC, UCI_MHEALTH, FIGSHARE_CELSS, SYNTHETIC_A01.

data_class.description: Mandatory data classification. measured_real = actually collected measurements (ISS telemetry, space weather). analog = real human data NOT from astronauts (MIMIC, MHEALTH, Sleep-EDF). synthetic = generated by IRCO (scenario A-01, etc.).

context.description: Contextual metadata specific to the observation domain.

mission.description: Mission identifier if applicable (RR-1, OSD-575, ISS-Expedition-72, etc.).

environment.description: Environment of measurement: ISS_cabin, ground_lab, simulation, hospital_icu, etc.

activity.description: Activity during measurement: rest, exercise, sleep, EVA, etc.

provenance.description: Traceability back to the original raw data.

original_record.description: Row number, record ID, or key in original file.

original_unit.description: Unit in the original data before conversion.

original_timestamp.description: Original timestamp string before UTC normalization.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file.

download_url.description: URL from which the source file was obtained.

license.description: License of the source data: public_domain, CC-BY-4.0, PhysioNet-CDA, etc.

quality.description: Data quality assessment performed during normalization.

flags.description: Quality flags: out_of_range, stale, gap_filled, duplicate_removed, etc.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata for source-specific fields that don't fit elsewhere.
